source_scope: Code candidate validation artifact; includes historical committed docs, not the completed current-batch report. Unpublished and unsigned.
checks: Archive SHA-256 matches retained checksum and unsigned provenance
BUILD target/version/source match clean code candidate
Metadata distinguishes packaging smoke from external unit-test evidence
Archive entries are bounded regular files/directories under one relative root; executable mode retained
Internal/external BUILD and SBOM agree; executable hash verified
Every dependency notice coverage entry and notice hash verified
limits: Unsigned local records and checksums do not authenticate a publisher
Fresh build and package checks do not prove bit-for-bit reproducibility
No signing, notarization, publication or installation into a global binary directory performed

exact_binary_regressions.scope: Exact executable extracted from this unsigned candidate archive.
